نكتشف (form VIII)
# نَكْتَشِفُ (naktašifu) /nak.ta.ʃi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# نُكْتَشَفُ (nuktašafu) /nuk.ta.ʃa.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# نَكْتَشِفَ (naktašifa) /nak.ta.ʃi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# نُكْتَشَفَ (nuktašafa) /nuk.ta.ʃa.fa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
